answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a foundational kernel for Sybil resistance, requiring agents to solve unique biometric or cryptographic challenges to acquire status. Much like a sparrow navigating complex environments, an attacker attempting a spiral of fake accounts faces escalating costs, as each identity necessitates unique, non-duplicable verification inputs. This resource-intensive barrier forces the cost of identity generation to exceed the expected utility of the sybil-controlled nodes.
